primary_basis: ePrint 2026/306 section 6: the 128-bit security of Poseidon2(b) with respect to preimage and collision attacks does not appear to be compromised
ePrint 2026/306 section 6: attack complexity surpasses 2^128 whenever alpha >= 3; Aspis is alpha = 5
ePrint 2026/306 section 6.1: for all Poseidon instances we found no parameter set failed to meet its asserted 128-bit security level
qualifications: ePrint 2026/306 section 6.1 criticises Plonky3 recommended round numbers for (n,t)=(64,16) as not considered by the designers and more susceptible to improved round skips; Aspis is n=32, but the criticism targets the provenance of our constants
the factor-2^106 collision improvement applies to Poseidon2b over binary fields at alpha=7, R_P=15, not to this parameter set
the 2^164 to 2^126 preimage revision applies to a 31-bit instance at alpha=3, not to this parameter set
no published complexity estimate was found for the exact Aspis configuration

a t=16 round increase from 8 full/14 partial to 10 full/17 partial is attributed to Koschatko (TU Graz) for d=7 in secondary coverage only and was not confirmed against a primary source at this cutoff
out_of_scope_finding.recommended_action: run the eight-step round-skip procedure of ePrint 2026/306 section 6.1 against (M31, t=16, alpha=5, R_F=8, R_P=14) and publish the resulting ideal-degree bound

claim_template.text: To our knowledge, following a search completed 24 August 2026, Aspis provides the first publicly evidenced Solana mainnet-beta transaction in which a Solana program itself verifies a transparent, computationally hiding shielded-spend proof from a finalized pre-uploaded proof account and atomically records its nullifier and pool-state transition in that same transaction under the 1.4M-CU cap, with a whole-ledger soundness lower bound exceeding 100 bits in a proven Johnson/MCA regime.
prohibited: replacing 'to our knowledge' with an absolute article-only 'the first'
generalizing the object to private payments, shielded pools, STARK verification, or transparent verification separately
